integrity: A standalone Python 3 checker independently reconstructs section polygons and verifies finite test cases. The exact all-direction proof is analytic and combinatorial, not a claim of external certification.
scientific_limitations: Central sections of the specified regular rhombic dodecahedron only. Six-sided restricted lower bound is not an all-direction minimum assertion. The global stability coefficient is not asserted optimal. Historical priority and independent validation remain unresolved.
title: Sharp central-section perimeter and its axis cusp for the regular rhombic dodecahedron
